tools.name: scan_domain
tools.description: Scores how well a dApp or website domain is protected against hijacking: registrar transfer/update locks, registry lock, DNSSEC, CAA, expiry, nameserver consistency across resolvers, SRI on third-party scripts and the Content-Security-Policy header. Returns a 0-100 score, each check with pass/fail/u

tools.name: check_registry_lock
tools.description: Reads the domain's EPP status codes from RDAP and tells whether registry lock (serverUpdateProhibited + serverTransferProhibited) is on, partly on or off, and which registrar-level locks are set.

tools.name: check_sri
tools.description: Loads a public page and lists every script, stylesheet and preload it pulls in. For third-party files, checks whether an integrity= hash is present and matches, and returns a ready sha384 hash for files that have none.

tools.name: check_seal_dns_registrar
tools.description: Goes through the 16 controls of the SEAL Security Frameworks certification for DNS & Registrar and marks what public data shows for each: ok, partial, gap, not visible from outside, or a process control the team has to document itself. Includes DNSSEC, CAA, SPF/DMARC/MTA-STS, locks, expiry and secur
